calibration.subject: algebra
lessons: Candidate-rich scans overlink ordinary mathematical vocabulary and repeated occurrences; review must prioritize first defining uses and reader questions.
A target with a misleading lexical match can be worse than leaving a phrase unlinked: categorical cokernel must not resolve to module cokernel.
Core links should expose prerequisites of the minimal definition, while examples and motivational subject-area phrases generally remain unlinked.
Ambiguous topology targets should be selected by mathematical context; convex-analysis/open-subset is inappropriate for Zariski topology.
